page.layout: One printed page, a title page, set centred in lines. The page is very faint, and mirrored show-through from the reverse side shows at the top and through the text, so most lines are doubtful.
page.notes: The page is mostly faint. The number at the top and the mirrored lines through the middle are show-through from the reverse side and are not transcribed. Readings marked [?] are doubtful. Several lines are too faint to read and are marked illegible. No engraving or ornament is visible.
